name: Zoho Projects
description: Zoho Projects is an online project management platform for planning, tracking, and collaborating on work, with deep integration into the wider Zoho suite.
best_for: Teams already using Zoho apps, and organizations across construction, IT, and services looking for an affordable, feature-rich project tool.
features: Gantt charts for project plans and task scheduling
Timesheet module for billable and non-billable hours
Integration with Zoho Invoice for automatic billing
Resource allocation tools to prevent overload
Integrations with Slack, GitHub, Jira, and Office 365

tiers.name: Free
tiers.notes: Up to 5 users; 3 projects, subtasks, whiteboard, and 5GB storage.

tiers.name: Premium
tiers.notes: Unlimited projects, task blueprints, project budgeting, and timesheets ($5/user/mo billed monthly).

tiers.name: Enterprise
tiers.notes: Adds custom profiles/roles, SSO, 2FA, portfolio dashboard, and critical path/baseline ($10/user/mo billed monthly).

tiers.name: Ultimate
tiers.notes: Adds unlimited custom dashboards, multi-user timesheets, and 100 resources ($15/user/mo billed monthly).
